raw_html: [[Slicing Winds#| Slicing Winds]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Slicing Winds#| Slicing Winds]]:''' This weapon stores the cyclonic might of a windstorm within. When this weapon is used, this power can come to the surface as a series of rushing, cutting winds that deal slashing damage to the target over several seconds.
